explanation: I searched Mathlib for coefficient lemmas on powers of X - C a. These were `coeff_X_add_C_pow`, `nextCoeff_X_sub_C`, `Monic.nextCoeff_pow` and `coeff_X_sub_C_mul`. None states the coefficient of (X - C x₀)^(p^t·m) at p^t·(m-1) in characteristic p. The library's proof uses `coeff_X_add_C_pow` only as one ingredient, after `sub_pow_char_pow`, `expand` and `coeff_expand_mul`. `Monic.nextCoeff_pow` gives only the next coefficient of (X - C x₀)^n. Applying it to n = p^t·m would give the coefficient at p^t·m - 1, not p^t·(m-1), so it doesn't match. I found no single declaration from which this follows in one or two lines.
